info.title: OpenVIBES Console API
info.description: Versioned human and service-account API for the OpenVIBES console.

200.description: Roles, active bindings, and asset groups
Agent counts visible to the current user

413.description: Export exceeds the row or byte limit

403.description: Origin, CSRF, or permission check failed

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Required RFC 3339 lower bound for partition pruning

parameters.name: rule_set_id
parameters.description: Exact rule-set filter; ~unknown selects legacy rows

get.summary: Reports the current authenticated browser session.
get.description:
The C0 router deliberately returns a bounded failure instead of creating a
temporary unauthenticated or implicitly privileged session.

503.description: Authentication is not implemented until C3

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: Must exactly match the configured public origin

200.description: Authenticated; sets an opaque session cookie

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: Must exactly match the configured public origin

parameters.name: X-CSRF-Token
parameters.description: Synchronizer token returned by the session route

AccessAssetGroup.description: Manual asset group and exact selectors.

selectors.description: Exact `key=value` selectors, all of which must match.

asset_group_id.description: Asset group id; null denotes global scope.

AccessInventory.description: Read-only review of roles, bindings, and asset groups.

asset_groups.description: Manual asset groups and their exact tag selectors.

roles.description: All available roles and granted permission identifiers.

builtin.description: Whether this is a built-in role.

AgentPage.description: A page of agents using the shared cursor response shape.

generated_at.description: RFC 3339 instant when this page was generated.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or `null` at the end.

AgentStatus.description: Lifecycle state reported for an enrolled agent.

AgentSummary.description: Fleet counts visible to the current principal.

AgentView.description: Operator-facing agent fields shared by the read API and seeded server.

hostname.description: Latest hostname reported by an authenticated heartbeat; this is an operator label.

last_seen_at.description: RFC 3339 time of the latest heartbeat, if present.

AuditEventPage.description: Bounded audit-event page with an opaque continuation cursor.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, if present.

AuditEventView.description: One safe audit event in a bounded audit search.

retention_days.description: Number of days kept after the next maintenance run.

updated_by.description: Local user id that last changed the policy.

AuthenticationLevel.description: Authentication assurance reached by the current browser session.

AuthenticationMethod.description: Authentication mechanism that established a browser session.

CertificatePage.description: A page of certificate metadata using the shared cursor response shape.

generated_at.description: RFC 3339 instant when this page was generated.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or `null` at the end.

CertificateView.description: Certificate metadata exposed in an agent detail response.

CursorPagination.description: Validated cursor and limit accepted by cursor-paginated collection routes.

EffectiveCapability.description: One effective capability returned to the browser.

permission.description: Permission granted to the current principal.

scope.description: Effective global or asset-group scope for the permission.

FieldError.description: Safe validation detail for one request field.

field.description: Stable JSON field name or dotted field path.

authenticated.description: Whether the observation was received through an authenticated agent.

confidence.description: Confidence as a percentage from 0 through 100.

evidence.description: Evidence key/value strings from the observation.

id.description: Finding identifier from the partitioned event table.

observed_at.description: RFC 3339 time the agent or importer observed this finding.

observed_day.description: UTC partition day used for stable event lookup.

received_at.description: RFC 3339 time the platform received this observation.

rule_id.description: Rule identifier within the rule set.

rule_set_id.description: Rule set that produced the event, or `~unknown` for legacy data.

FindingHistoryPage.description: A page of historical observation events using the shared cursor response shape.

generated_at.description: RFC 3339 instant when this page was generated.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or `null` at the end.

FindingPage.description: A page of latest observations using the shared cursor response shape.

generated_at.description: RFC 3339 instant when this page was generated.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or `null` at the end.

FindingSummary.description: Counts for the latest observation rows visible to the current principal.

impacted_agents.description: Number of visible agents with at least one latest observation.

total.description: Number of visible latest observation rows.

FindingView.description: Latest observation state for one agent, rule set, and rule.

authenticated.description: Whether the observation was received through an authenticated agent.

confidence.description: Confidence as a percentage from 0 through 100.

evidence.description: Evidence key/value strings from the observation.

first_observed_at.description: RFC 3339 time of the first observation.

hostname.description: Latest hostname reported by the agent; this is an operator label.

last_observed_at.description: RFC 3339 time of the latest observation.

received_at.description: RFC 3339 time the platform received this observation.

rule_id.description: Rule identifier within the rule set.

rule_set_id.description: Rule set that produced the finding, or `~unknown` for legacy data.

LoginRequest.description: One-use local login request. The password is never echoed by the API.

password.description: Password supplied over the configured secure transport.

username.description: Canonical local username (case is normalized by the server).

LoginResponse.description: Acknowledgement returned after a local password login succeeds.

authenticated.description: Always true for the successful response; the session cookie is set separately.

oneOf.description: The permission applies only to the listed asset groups.

asset_group_ids.description: Stable asset-group identifiers selected by the binding resolver.

PermissionScope.description: Effective object scope attached to one permission.

PreauthResponse.description: CSRF challenge returned before local password login.

csrf_token.description: One-use value required in `X-CSRF-Token` on the login request.

ProblemDetails.description: Stable RFC Problem Details-style error response used by the console API.

field_errors.description: Bounded request-field errors when validation can safely identify them.

SessionPrincipal.description: Human principal represented by an authenticated browser session.

id.description: Stable local or federated user identifier.

username.description: Local username when the identity has one.

SessionResponse.description: Successful response from `GET /api/v1/session` for an active session.

authentication_level.description: Assurance reached by the current session.

capabilities.description: Effective permissions and their scopes, resolved for this request.

csrf_token.description: Per-session value required in `X-CSRF-Token` on unsafe browser requests.

idle_expires_at.description: RFC 3339 instant when idle expiry occurs if the session is not used.

principal.description: Current human principal. Service-account tokens cannot call this route.

Severity.description: Severity attached to the latest observation for a rule.

UpdateAuditRetentionRequest.description: Request body for changing audit retention.

retention_days.description: Retention window in days, from 1 through 36500.
